prompt: I read that the US Access Board issued a Section 508 refresh NPRM in October 2026. Is that true, and what standards actually bind us?
assertions: States no: no Section 508 refresh rulemaking is under way as of November 2026
Explains the 2026 reports trace back to the 2015 proposed rule and are not supported by the Federal Register record
States the operative baseline: the 2017 Revised 508 Standards (82 FR 5790, January 18, 2017) incorporating WCAG 2.0 Level AA
Notes compliance has been required since January 18, 2018, with the legacy safe harbor for unaltered ICT
Identifies the actual 2026 Access Board rulemakings as unrelated (universal changing stations ANPRM and FOIA regulations) or at minimum confirms no ICT rulemaking exists
